[User #1763818230 postsTicTacToetrained chickenWhirlpool Forums Addict] eddiesun writes...
when is best time to buy Singapore airline ticket to euro about 30th march to early April next year
Google Flights generally can provide you its guesstimate, as well as its view on if current pricing is high, typical or low.
i heard they they on sales in September
Typically, but as others have pointed out – arguments about insurance and DFAT travel status aside – demand is still impacted by some people putting a premium on not flying via the ME airlines due to uncertainty about ongoing regional instability.
I'd be surprised if they don't run their normal early bird sales but it doesn't necessarily mean they'll discount as deeply as they may have done in the past (indeed I'd suggest all things considered that's relatively unlikely).
[User #178666980 postsNoddy1it's got a broken fretWhirlpool Forums Addict] eddiesun writes...
when is best time to buy Singapore airline ticket to euro about 30th march to early April next year
My wife and I have travelled to Europe 3 times since covid ended. Each time in the March-April-May time frame with SIA. (My wife flew with Emirates once as an additional trip) The cheapest time (with the best choice of connections/flight times) in our experience has been within a month or so of the ticket being available for purchase. They do have some sales later in the year but the connections/flight times choices are more limited by then.
